mapper.insert: INSERT INTO item_message (item_id, from_student_id, to_student_id, content, create_time) VALUES (#{itemId}, #{fromStudentId}, #{toStudentId}, #{content}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.item_id AS itemId, m.from_student_id AS fromStudentId, fs.name AS fromStudentName, m.to_student_id AS toStudentId, ts.name AS toStudentName, m.content, m.create_time AS createTime, (m.from_student_id = si.student_id) AS fromSeller FROM item_message m LEFT JOIN student fs ON m.from_student_id = fs.id LEFT JOIN student ts ON m.to_student_id = ts.id LEFT JOIN secondhand_item si ON m.item_id = si.id WHERE m.item_id = #{itemId} ORDER BY m.create_time ASC
